2024 Six-Coin Proof Year Set – HM King Charles III
items.description:
This 2024 Six-Coin Proof Year Set captures a moment in history not witnessed in more than seven decades, as this treasured annual release undergoes a majestic transition to the new effigy of His Majesty, King Charles III by designer Dan Thorne.

The first set to feature the King Charles III effigy on all six of Australia’s circulating coin designs, this release bears an historic significance that is sure to cement their position as a centrepiece in collections across the world.

items.name: 2024 Six-Coin Uncirculated Year Set – HM King Charles III
items.description:
A momentous occasion in numismatic history is captured with this highly anticipated 2024 Six-Coin Uncirculated Year Set, the first to feature the new effigy of His Majesty, King Charles III, on each of Australia's circulating coin designs.

Add this once in a lifetime release to your collection today.

items.name: 2024 Six-Coin Uncirculated Baby Set
items.description:
Help celebrate the arrival of a new bub with this 2024 Six-Coin Uncirculated Baby Coin Year Set. 

Everyone is getting into the fun and games as the Royal Australian Mint’s much loved baby coins return. The bright eyed and giggling baby is surrounded by a gang of mates including the adorable wooden echidna, the winky-wonky lyrebird, the wet windup platypus and the cute and cuddly plush emu and roo.
